fluff.overview: ComStar organized its military forces around a combined-arms doctrine that valued infantry as an essential element of the Level I through Level VI command structure, with conventional platoons serving alongside BattleMechs, armor, and aerospace assets at every echelon. Motorized platoons use light vehicles to achieve ground speeds well beyond foot infantry, allowing rapid redeployment between defensive positions. Their wheeled or motorcycle transport keeps the formation mobile on developed road networks, though off-road performance is limited. Carrying infantry-portable machine guns that provide sustained suppressive fire, these troops anchor defensive positions with a volume of fire that discourages enemy movement in the open.
